div.div:
Why three new hosts
The transfer host talks to vendors and holds no directory rights.
The processor is the one writer to AD and is not a domain controller.
The sync server carries replication rights, so it does nothing else.
Each hop has its own identity, its own log and a firewall between it and the next.
